The first public version of WorkSync: a desktop task tracker for project
managers whose customers send task lists as Excel files in another language.

## Download

| System                    | File                              |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| Windows (64-bit)          | `WorkSync-win32-x64-0.1.0.zip`    |
| macOS (Apple silicon)     | `WorkSync-darwin-arm64-0.1.0.zip` |
| Linux, Debian or Ubuntu   | `worksync_0.1.0_amd64.deb`        |
| Linux, Fedora or openSUSE | `worksync-0.1.0-1.x86_64.rpm`     |

- **Windows:** unzip into a folder on a local drive and run `worksync.exe`.
  Nothing is installed.
- **macOS:** unzip and move `WorkSync.app` to Applications.
- **Linux:** install the package.

The builds aren't code signed yet, so Windows and macOS warn the first time.
See [Download and run](https://github.com/KelvinNguyen97/WorkSync#download-and-run)
for how to open the app anyway.

## What's in it

- Linked customer files (`.xlsx`, `.xlsm`, `.xls`, `.csv`). You review each new
  version before it changes anything, and your changes are written back into
  your own copy.
- A translation, summary, situation, difficulties, notes and next action for
  every task, with a glossary and people list per project.
- Focus, Board, Tasks, Timeline, Calendar and Dashboard views, with filters.
- Translation and summaries through any AI chat, by copy and paste. No API key
  is needed.
- Excel and Word reports, also in the customer's language.
- A read-only page published to a shared folder, and project copies to give to
  other WorkSync users.
- Daily backups, and light and dark mode.

This is an early version, so expect rough edges. Please report problems on the
[Issues page](https://github.com/KelvinNguyen97/WorkSync/issues).
